shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references; rg -n -i "chart" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -40

sed -n 15,40p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n 128,148p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n 494,510p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat AGENTS.md | head -30; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; cat src/*.tsx | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm i @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr 2>&1 | tail -15; for p in chartkit charts yagr; do echo "== $p"; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/build/docs 2>&1 | head -5; grep -A12 '"peerDependencies"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/$p/package.json; done
for v in 8 7 6; do echo "chartkit@$v"; npm view "@gravity-ui/chartkit@$v" version peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -4; done; npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json | tail -15
npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20; npm i @gravity-ui/chartkit@8.12.0 2>&1 | tail -15

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; ls $D $D/build 2>&1 | head -30; ls $D/build/docs $D/dist/docs 2>&1 | head; grep -n -i -E "lazy|registerPlugins|settings|yagr|gravity-charts|ChartKitWidget" $D/README.md | head -50

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; cat $D/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -40; ls -R $D/build/docs/guides | head -30; sed -n 1,125p $D/README.md; grep -n -E "peerDep|optional" -A8 $D/package.json | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; ls $D/node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat $D/package.json | grep -n -A25 '"exports"' | head -40; ls $D/build/plugins $D/build/plugins/yagr $D/build/plugins/gravity-charts; cat $D/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts; cat $D/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts; cat $D/build/types/widget.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,60p $D/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit; cat $D/build/types/index.d.ts | head -80; cat $D/build/index.d.ts; ls $D/build/plugins/yagr/renderer; grep -n -E "xAxis|axes|chart:|series|scales|title" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts | head -0; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist | head -30; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json $D/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json

Y=node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist; grep -n -E "^\s+(title|chart|axes|scales|series|timeline|settings|tooltip|legend|cursor|editable)\??:" $Y/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -30; grep -n -E "interface (RawSerieData|MinimalValidConfig)|type (RawSerieData|MinimalValidConfig)" -A14 $Y/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -60; C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist; ls $C | head; grep -n -E "export type (ChartData|ChartXAxis|LineSeries)\b" -A22 $C/types/chart/*.d.ts | grep -n -E "type|xAxis|yAxis|series|title|categories|timestamps|legend" | head -40

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; ls $C/dist/docs | head; grep -rn -E "type: 'datetime'|type: \"datetime\"" $C/dist/docs | head -5; grep -rln "ChartData = " $C/dist --include=*.d.ts | head -3; sed -n 20,50p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts; sed -n 220,300p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | grep -n -E "^\s+(name|id|data|color|scale|type|lineWidth|show|points)\??:"

C=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; grep -rn -i -E "datetime|xAxis" $C/dist/docs/get-started.md $C/dist/docs/examples.md | head -12; grep -rn "datetime" $C/dist --include=*.d.ts | head -5; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -0; grep -n "interface YagrChartOptions" -A30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -45

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build; grep -n -i "theme" $D/plugins/yagr/renderer/useWidgetData.js $D/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.js | head; grep -n -E "set\(|plugins" $D/libs/settings/settings.js | head; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/cjs/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -n -E "^\s+(type|labels|title|timestamps|categories)\??:"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -20

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup RadioButton Card Loader Flex Text 2>&1 | head -40; rg -n "header-3|Heading|flex contract" -i .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; ls $U | grep -E "^(SegmentedRadioGroup|RadioButton|Card|Loader|Text|Flex|Alert)$"; cat $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; sed -n 53,110p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "ControlGroupProps" -B2 -A22 $U/components/types.d.ts | head -50; grep -n -E "Flex|Card|Loader|Text'|Alert" $U/components/index.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins; cat $D/gravity-charts/index.js $D/yagr/index.js; grep -n "export type ChartData\b\|export interface ChartData\b" -A40 -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/index.d.ts | grep -E "^\S*-\s+(xAxis|yAxis|series|title|legend|tooltip)" ; grep -n "Text\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -3
rm -rf dist && git status --short
